The Supreme Court's decision to dismiss Karnataka's appeal against bike taxis has revived debate over urban mobility, public transport gaps and last-mile connectivity.
With Bengaluru continuing to face severe congestion, inadequate bus capacity and growing demand for flexible transport options, the discussion is shifting from whether bike taxis should exist to how they should be regulated. Questions around safety, driver welfare, platform economics and commuter convenience are now central to the debate.
